D1-61
DIAGNOSTICS ENGINE
INSPECTION PROCEDURE
HINT:
Read freeze frame data using TOYOTA hand-held tester or 08D II scan tool. Because freeze frame records
the engine conditions when the malfunction is detected, when troubleshootlng it is useful for determining
whether the vehicle was running or stopped, the engine warmed up or not, the air-fuel ratio lean or rich, etc.
at the time of the malfunction.
1 Check air Induction system (See page SF-1 ).
Repair or replace. GI
2 Check Injector Injection (See page SF-22). I I Replace Injector. GI
3 Check mass air flow meter and engine coolant temp. sensor (See page SF-63, SF-31).
Repair or replace. GI
[:J
Check for spark and Ignition (See page IG-1 ).
4 I I Repair or replace. GI
